A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same study and complete Appendices A–D. Text and rendered pages 2–35 are identical; page 1 differs only in authorship and arXiv version/date information.

before.justification: v1 reports original training experiments with 14M–472M language models, loss-deceleration measurements, gradient-interference analyses and appendix ablations.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original experiments and analyses, including Table 1, Sections 3–4 and the appendix ablations.

M1.justification: BNSL fitting, destructive-interference measurements and the gradient proxy in Appendix A.3 use identical procedures in both versions.

E1.justification: Both retain the same OLMo training data, C4 evaluation, OpenWebText2 experiments and downstream-task coverage described in Appendices A.1, B.3 and C.2.

E2.justification: Comparison methods are unchanged, including AdamW, Muon and AdEMAMix in Appendix C.2, Table 6 and Figures 26–27.

E3.justification: Model sizes, training schedules, batch sizes, checkpointing, metrics and evaluation procedures remain identical in the main text and appendices.

E4.justification: Both contain identical gradient-proxy validation, step-interval and loss-landscape analyses, and batch-size, sequence-length, optimizer and learning-rate ablations in Appendices A–C.

E5.justification: Fitted-parameter standard deviations and statistical reporting in Tables 4–6 and 8 are identical. No run-count, seed or uncertainty-estimation information changes.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout, including loss-deceleration measurements in Table 1, optimizer results in Table 6 and learning-rate-decay results in Tables 7–8.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations, first-order dynamics derivation in Appendix B.1 and exploratory scaling-law formulation in Appendix B.6 are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about scaling mitigating loss deceleration and zero-sum learning explaining the underlying training bottleneck.

C2.justification: Mechanistic interpretations, the Limitations section and appendix qualifications are identical, including gradient-proxy discrepancies and the preliminary status of the proposed scaling law.

D1.justification: Appendix A retains identical hyperparameters, implementation code, hardware and training-time disclosures, and checkpoint availability information. Code and artifact links are unchanged.

R1.justification: The references, introduction and related-work discussion in Appendix D are identical, with no added citations or changes in research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 adds Milind Naphade and Sambit Sahu to the author list and updates the arXiv stamp from 5 June to 14 July 2025. The body text and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions and page layout remain unchanged. The expanded byline fits within the existing header structure, and pages 2–35 render identically.

improvement.justification: The revision changes authorship and version metadata only. Scientific content, supporting evidence, limitations, reproducibility information and substantive presentation remain identical, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
